{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Event Handlers

|gr2= Sounds

|descr= Removes specified music track event handler. See {{Link|Arma 3: Event Handlers#Music Event Handlers}}.

|s1= [[removeMusicEventHandler]] [type, id]

|p1= type: [[String]] - "MusicStart" or "MusicStop"

|p2= id: [[Number]] - event handler id

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>removeMusicEventHandler ["MusicStart", 12];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>removeMusicEventHandler ["MusicStop", 12];</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>
private _stopMusicEH = addMusicEventHandler ["MusicStop", {}];
// ...
removeMusicEventHandler ["MusicStop", _stopMusicEH];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[addMusicEventHandler]] {{Link|Arma 3: Event Handlers#Music Event Handlers}} [[setMusicEventHandler]] [[removeAllMusicEventHandlers]] [[playMusic]]
}}
